extracted.name: Leek and Potato Soup
extracted.description: Creamy and comforting for a cold winter day, this leek and potato soup is ready to serve in under an hour.
ingredient_lines: 3 large leeks (white and pale green parts only), chopped
3 medium Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cubed
1 cup heavy cream, or to taste
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add leeks and cook and stir until softened, about 5 minutes. Stir in celery; cook and stir until softened, about 5 minutes more. Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Stir in potatoes, vegetable broth, and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until potatoes are tender and easily pierced with a fork, about 25 minutes.
Blend using an immersion blender or in a regular blender in batches. Stir in heavy cream until heated through. Season to taste with salt.
